title: Session, BPC, Concord, NC vs. Central Carolina Presbytery
disposition_detail: Complaint not sustained. Issue 1 (whether Central Carolina Presbytery erred in accepting the moderator's ruling declaring RE Dollar's confirmation null and void absent sessional approval): No. Issue 2 (whether the record shows an appearance of prejudice against RE Dollar): No. SJC vote: 11 concurring, 7 dissenting, 6 absent.
first_summary: The Session of Bible Presbyterian Church, Concord, complained that Central Carolina Presbytery improperly let Christ Covenant Session block RE Chris Dollar's appointment to the Candidates Committee. The SJC affirmed the Presbytery's action, holding the moderator properly declared the appointment null and void. It also found no appearance of prejudice. The vote was 11-7, with a dissent arguing the case should be remanded.
summary: The Session of Bible Presbyterian Church, Concord, complained that Central Carolina Presbytery wrongly accepted its moderator's ruling making RE Chris Dollar's interim Candidates Committee appointment "null and void" because Christ Covenant Session never approved it. The SJC answered both issues no and did not sustain the complaint, leaving Presbytery's action undisturbed. It reasoned that approval was conditional under CCP rules, the moderator expressed Presbytery's intention, Presbytery did not surrender jurisdiction, and BCO 39-3 required deference; it found no appearance of prejudice. Vote 11-7, with dissents urging remand and challenging sessional control over committee eligibility.
